prediction_text: 狗能找回。往伦敦城内偏西、向南微偏的方位寻：狗主星在西方星座、南象限偏西，且与上升同三方性主狗仍在伦敦城内未出城；狗主星拱六宫头主终有找回之象。月亮在风象星座、日光下被掩主一时难见、踪迹不明。应期日档，窗口数日内至下个周一，主坐标为周一（输入载太阳于随后周一以顺相位临上升主土星）前后寻得/得讯。寻的重点区域：城西偏南一带。
basis: systems_used=['horary (Lilly, lost animal / 6th house)']; dog signified by 6th sign and lord; western sign + southern quarter verging west gives direction west inclining south; same triplicity as Ascendant = still in London; applying trine to cusp of 6th = recovery; Moon in airy sign under beams = presently hidden. Timing: Sun applying to Saturn lord Asc on following Monday taken as main coordinate; other routes lack degrees.
